name: Cueva del Guácharo, Caripe
note: 1799 年 9 月，洪堡和邦普兰由卡里佩修道院的修士和印第安向导陪着走进这个山洞，第一次向欧洲描述了洞里成千上万只夜行的油鸱。当地人相信祖先的灵魂住在洞的深处，向导们不肯再往里走；洪堡则说这是希腊人的冥界塔耳塔罗斯，鸟叫声就像冥河边的鸟。这里是委内瑞拉第一个自然纪念地，就以洪堡命名，今天可以提着灯走进洞里，傍晚还能看到鸟群飞出洞口
note_en: In September 1799 Humboldt and Bonpland walked into this cave with the monks of the Caripe mission and their Indigenous guides, and gave Europe its first description of the thousands of oilbirds that nest in the dark. The local people believed the souls of their ancestors lived in its depths, and the guides refused to go any farther; Humboldt called it the Tartarus of the Greeks and compared the birds' cries to the birds of the Styx. It was Venezuela's first natural monument and is named after him. You can walk in by lantern light, and at dusk watch the birds pour out of the mouth

name: Salto La Llovizna, Caroní River
name_zh: 卡罗尼河 · 细雨瀑布
note: 1595 年，沃尔特·雷利沿奥里诺科河寻找传说中的黄金国，在卡罗尼河边远远看见“十几道瀑布，一道比一道高，每道都有教堂塔楼那么高”，水汽升起来，他起初还以为是一座大城的炊烟。人们一般认为他看到的就是卡罗尼河下游靠近河口的这一带瀑布。今天细雨瀑布在圭亚那城的公园里，有栈道和石阶可以走到水边
note_en: In 1595 Walter Raleigh, hunting up the Orinoco for the fabled city of El Dorado, saw from a hilltop on the Caroní 'ten or twelve overfalls', each 'as high over the other as a church tower', throwing up so much spray that he first took it for the smoke of some great town. His falls are usually placed on this lower stretch of the Caroní near its mouth. Today La Llovizna lies inside a park in Ciudad Guayana, with boardwalks and stepping stones that take you down to the water

name: Paseo Orinoco, Ciudad Bolívar
name_zh: 玻利瓦尔城 · 奥里诺科河滨大道
note: 奥里诺科河在这里收窄成一道“窄口”，城市因此叫了两百年“安戈斯图拉”，著名的安戈斯图拉苦精就是在这里调制出来的。1819 年玻利瓦尔在此召开国会，城市从此改用他的名字。1910 年扎姆坐船到这里，记下了 1891 年那场大水：街上游着鳄鱼，人在自家院子里就能钓到一顿饭的鱼。沿河的大道上还是一排排殖民时期的拱廊房子，河中央那块“中间石”至今仍是看水位的标尺
note_en: Here the Orinoco squeezes into a narrows, and for two centuries the city was called Angostura, the name that went round the world on bottles of Angostura bitters, first mixed here. In 1819 Bolívar convened a congress in the town, and it was renamed after him. When Zahm arrived by steamer in 1910 he wrote down the story of the great flood of 1891, when alligators swam in the streets and you could catch dinner in your own courtyard. The riverside promenade is still lined with arcaded colonial houses, and the rock in midstream is still used to read the height of the river

name: Mount Roraima
prototype_of: 《失落的世界》里那座与世隔绝、恐龙仍在游荡的高原的原型：查林杰教授一行穿过丛林，终于望见“那一线高高的红色悬崖”。罗赖马山是一座四面峭壁的平顶山，委内瑞拉、巴西和圭亚那三国在山顶交界；1884 年第一批欧洲人登顶的消息，据说正是柯南·道尔的灵感来源。今天从委内瑞拉一侧徒步，往返通常要六天左右
prototype_of_en: The model for the isolated plateau where dinosaurs still roam in The Lost World, which Professor Challenger's party finally sights across the jungle as 'the line of high red cliffs'. Roraima is a sheer-sided table mountain where Venezuela, Brazil and Guyana meet on the summit, and the news of the first European ascent in 1884 is said to have given Conan Doyle the idea. Today the trek from the Venezuelan side usually takes about six days there and back
